news.title: Man Found Guilty in 2023 Stabbings Near UC Davis, and Is Ruled Insane
news.summary: A jury this week found Carlos Reales Dominguez guilty of involuntary manslaughter in two deaths, but a judge ruled that he was insane at the time of the crimes. He faces time in a mental hospital.
